plan.notes: Official Eastern Oregon University 2026-2027 catalog, Psychology Major requirements (Required Core 20 cr + 300-level 25 cr + 400-level 15 cr + capstone 5-6 cr = 65-66). The catalog publishes degree requirements with no official semester sequence: the linked "Typical Four Year Curriculum" page is a JavaScript-gated gateway with no extractable term data, so this plan is recorded as a single requirements block. Capstone recorded at the 5-credit minimum (Option One); Option Two totals 6 credits. Catalog publishes no official semester sequence.

courses.title: 300-level psychology electives (complete 25 credits)
courses.choice_note: Complete a minimum of 25 credit hours from: PSY 310 Selected Topics (1-6), PSY 311 Child Development (5), PSY 321 Stress & Disease (3), PSY 330 Emotion (5), PSY 331 Human Sexuality (5), PSY 335 Cognitive Psychology (5), PSY 342 Brain & Behavior (5), PSY 343 Learning (5), PSY 344 Sensation & Perception (5), PSY 345 Motivation (5), PSY 350 Psychopathology (5), PSY 357 Evolution & Behavior (5), PSY 360 Principles of Social Psychology (5), PSY 370 Personality (5). On-campus students complete the PSY 343L Learning Lab.

courses.title: 400-level psychology electives (complete 15 credits)
courses.choice_note: Complete a minimum of 15 credit hours from: PSY 407 Seminar (1-6), PSY 410 Selected Topics (1-6), PSY 424 Psychological Assessment (6), PSY 431 Advanced Topics in Human Sexuality (5), PSY 433 Psychopharmacology (5), PSY 436 Psychology of Diversity (5), PSY 442 Neuropsychology (5), PSY 443 Animal Cognition (5), PSY 451 Clinical Intervention (5), PSY 473 Family Systems Theory & Therapy (5).

courses.title: Psychology Research Topics
courses.choice_note: Capstone: complete one option. Option One: PSY 450 Psychology Research Topics (5 cr). Option Two: PSY 460 Experimental Psychology (3 cr) AND PSY 461 Research Experimental Psychology (3 cr) = 6 cr. Recorded at the 5-credit minimum (catalog total 65-66).
